title: Add TUI controller lifecycle tests
purpose: Prove that the TUI controller drives real AgentCore lifecycle without owning planner, resolver, policy or side-effect logic.
scope: Test submit, plan, advance and completed read-only runs.
Test pause-for-approval and exact approval success.
Test denial, timeout or approval mutation fail-closed behavior.
Test suspend and recover after rebuilding controller from durable paths.
Test demo mode remains isolated from durable mode.
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail if TUI bypasses AgentCore lifecycle APIs.
Tests fail if TUI prepares side effects directly.
Tests cover restart survival for pending approval and recovery.
failure_modes: Lifecycle tests only cover demo sessions.
Durability is not tested across controller reconstruction.
